response.answer: Veterans in audit roles often enhance corporate governance, but director tenure can dilute these effects over time. Long-term service may lead to complacency. Short tenures typically yield stronger impacts.

results.content: On January 22, 2021, President Joseph Biden issued Executive Order 14003, which abolished Schedule F before any positions were transferred into it.[10]  In April 2024 OPM issued a final rule (hereinafter the “April 2024 final rule”) amending the civil service regulations to (1) define policy-influencing positions to encompass only political appointments and have no applicability  ( printed page 17183)  to career Federal positions; (2) establish comprehensive procedures, including MSPB appeals, governing the transfer of positions to policy-influencing schedules in the excepted service; and (3) provide that any career incumbents moved into such policy-influencing excepted service schedules would remain subject to adverse actions procedural requirements and retain adverse action appeals.[11]. As previously discussed, chapter 75 adverse action procedures do not cover employees in excepted service positions that the President, OPM, or an agency head have determined are policy-influencing.[56]  Prior administrations had only applied this exemption only to political appointments, principally positions in Schedule C of the excepted service.[57]  Executive Order 13957 created a new Schedule F (following the pre-existing schedules A through E) for career employees in policy-influencing positions.[58].

results.title: Ja'Mel J. Brown announces campaign for Alabama Governor in ...
results.content: ## Blount County News's Post. ### **Blount County News**. Brown announces campaign for Alabama Governor in 2026. Brown, who made his announcement on social media this week, says he’s ready to “fight for the people of Alabama” and is committed to bringing practical, people-first leadership to Montgomery. • Releasing all nonviolent state prisoners. • Reforming child support laws to assist single parents. The campaign slogan, “Bama Made. Bama Win!”, reflects Brown’s emphasis on homegrown leadership and local investment. He’s also calling for a shift in bill payment structures from every 30 days to every 60 days—a unique approach he believes will reduce financial stress on working families.
